goal: Answer questions about the fictional Juniper shop using only its supplied policies. Keep answers short and do not invent facts.
source: Juniper is a fictional shop used only for this test. Orders ship within two business days. Unused items may be returned within 30 days. Support email: help@juniper.example.com. Support hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. There is no confirmed student discount policy.
